text:
Predicates:
Suck(x) ::: x sucks.
Vacuum(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
Vampire(x) ::: x is a vampire.
Space ::: space.
Duster(x) ::: x is a duster.
HouseholdAppliance(x) ::: x is a household appliance.

Premises:
Suck(plunger) ::: Plungers suck.
Suck(vacuum) ::: Vacuums suck.
Suck(vampire) ::: Vampires suck.
Vacuum(space) ::: Space is a vacuum.
HouseholdAppliance(duster) ∧ ¬Suck(duster) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.

Conclusion:
Space = vampire ::: Space is a vampire.
